dish: canh hạt tía tô / perilla-seed shiraegi soup + dolsot rice & a large banchan spread
address: Phú Mỹ Hưng, Tân Phong Ward, District 7 / Phú Mỹ Hưng, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A home-style Korean kitchen in the heart of Phú Mỹ Hưng's Korea Town, praised for one of Saigon's most generous, fresh-made banchan spreads and its signature perilla-seed shiraegi (dried-radish-leaf) soup served with a hot stone bowl of rice. Grandma-style cooking rather than a slick BBQ chain.

dish: ốc hương xào bơ (butter-sautéed sweet snails) & grilled shellfish
address: 383 Vĩnh Khánh, Ward 8, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: One of the busiest ốc (snail) houses on District 4's Vĩnh Khánh seafood strip, singled out by Rusty Compass and Will Fly for Food as a reliable, always-packed stop for cheap charcoal-grilled shellfish and stir-fried snails. English menu; open late.

dish: assorted ốc (snails, whelks) & shellfish, charcoal-grilled or stir-fried
address: 37 Vĩnh Khánh, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A long-standing snail-and-seafood eatery near the Vĩnh Khánh corner, flagged by Rusty Compass and Will Fly for Food as one of the strip's dependable, always-busy spots. Cheap, local, sidewalk-side dining with an English-translated menu.
